title: It’s annoying to lose something. Luckily, items found on ETH premises are usually handed in to the Lost and Found run by the Info + Service Centers (ISC) .
main_content:
Main article: It’s annoying to lose something. Luckily, items found on ETH premises are usually handed in to the Lost and Found run by the Info + Service Centers (ISC) .

Now ETH has linked up with the Swiss lost property platform easyfind.ch – so you can search online for your valuables at any time, even outside opening hours. You simply create a lost property notice, which is then regularly checked against the lost property handed in.

Mass-produced items at ISC: Lost property found on ETH premises can still be handed in or sought directly at ETH Lost and Found i.e. the ISC desk in the corresponding ETH location. The mass-produced items listed below cannot be recorded online; you should enquire about them at the ISC Lost and Found office:

• umbrellas
• hats, gloves, scarves, clothing
• drink bottles, reusable tableware
• toys
• sunglasses (non-corrective)
• writing material
To the ETH online lost property service ›
